name: Slime Ducts (Living Tar)
text:
Nearly invisible ducts in your skin secrete a layer of slime that coats your flesh.

Activate—Secrete Slime 1 (concentrate)

Requirements You activate the ducts, covering yourself with a thin layer of slime

---
Effect The black, tar-like sludge on your skin sticks to anything that touches it. The slime lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss the effect. You gain a +2 item bonus to checks to grab-an-edge, as well as to your Reflex DC against attempts to disarm you. A creature that hits you with a melee Strike must attempt a DC 25 Reflex save save.

---
Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls using the same weapon or appendage until it spends an action to pull the weapon or appendage free, or until you move.

Critical Failure If the Strike was made with a weapon, the creature is disarmed, and the weapon sticks to you until a creature Interacts to pull it free by succeeding at a DC 25 Athletics check check. If the Strike was made with an unarmed attack, the creature is Grabbed by you until it Escapes.
